Docker Compose guidance: service definitions, build options, env vars, ports, volumes, health-check dependencies, networks, resource limits, override files, profiles, lifecycle/build/monitoring commands, watch mode, DB init, Traefik reverse proxy, Compose secrets and extension fields.

Medium because the command reference has the agent run Docker on the user's machine: `docker compose up/build/pull` (pulls images from registries and starts containers), `exec`, `run`, scaling, and teardown including `docker compose down -v --rmi all` (SKILL.md:303), which deletes named volumes and their data. Acceptable: this is a local development tool the user asked to drive, the destructive variant is clearly labelled 'remove everything including volumes', and nothing targets remote infrastructure or disables security controls.

Users should know the dev sample hardcodes `POSTGRES_PASSWORD: secret` and publishes 5432/6379 on all interfaces (SKILL.md:44-63), and the Traefik example mounts /var/run/docker.sock (SKILL.md:416), which grants root-equivalent host access even when read-only; the reference file's Compose `secrets:` pattern is the safer option. Related Skills links `../docker-management/`, `../../orchestration/kubernetes-ops/`, `../../../infrastructure/networking/reverse-proxy/` (SKILL.md:456-458) are optional sibling skills that do not ship with this one.
